description: LOWELL, MA — Today, U.S. Senator Edward Markey endorsed Congresswoman Lori Trahan’s re-election campaign in Massachusetts’ Third Congressional District. Markey, who has represented Massachusetts in Washington since 1976 first as Congressman and subsequently as Senator, praised Trahan for her commitment to her district. “Representative Lori Trahan has been a fierce and effective advocate for her […]

title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
